name: Sài Gòn 2000s – playtest tools (cheats)
description: CHEATS for testing the Sài Gòn 2000s mod, not for real play.  Adds a "Playtester" profession to both Saigon scenarios (high skills, a full kit, money, gold and the mod's new items) and a playtest remote: teleport to the nearest chợ, đình, police HQ, army post, bia hơi, ice works or landmark; skip time; spawn a test vehicle on the nearest road or water; heal; damage protection; reveal the map; clear nearby monsters; flood or drain the streets.  See doc/saigon/PLAYTEST.md.  Leave this mod out of release builds and real games.
